name: Summit AZ - Schema Accuracy Audit 2026-10-08
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Read-only audit of all 190 sitemap URLs against Google's rule that structured data must accurately represent visible page content, followed by a re-check the next day (`Summit-AZ-Schema-Accuracy-Recheck-2026-10-09.md`). Per-page CSVs: `Summit-AZ-Schema-Accuracy-Audit-2026-10-08.csv` and `Summit-AZ-Schema-Accuracy-Recheck-2026-10-09.csv`.

# What passed
- 1,029 FAQ Q&As in 170 blocks matched the page (1,028 on the re-check). Service schema matched the page's service and city. Hours Mon to Sat 8 to 5 everywhere, no 24/7. No review or rating schema. Street address visible wherever used. Utah coordinates on /about/ gone.

# Problems
1. High: /about/ hand-coded business block with payment methods not shown on the page, a blank license field, a 404 logo, redirecting service links (one to Repiping) and a second business entity separate from Rank Math. The page also showed a "(Lic. #)" placeholder.
2. High: /home-warranty-plumbing/ advertises an unapproved service in schema; one FAQ answer no longer matched word for word; visible claim "thousands of plumbing repairs".
3. Medium: Rank Math default Article schema on about 150 service, city and legal pages.
4. Medium: 22 pages showed a WordPress username ("kim" or "scott-admin") as author.
5. Medium: Article image pointing to an OG image not on the page (35 pages). New on Oct 9: `priceRange: "$$"` on 123 city pages from the `summit-location-seo` plugin.
6. Low: shower and faucet pages list 10 cities in schema.

# Decisions and status
- Kim on Oct 9: "go fix 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6". Applied: /about/ block emptied; Pages default schema set to None (149 pages); 24 pages reassigned to author "Summit Plumbing Pros"; priceRange removed from the plugin (Scott's file, backed up). Problem 6 not changed after checking that the pages do visibly list all 10 cities.
- Still open: /home-warranty-plumbing/ keep, noindex or remove (Kim or Scott).
- Screenshots of the audited pages were saved under `Documentation\Summit Plumbing Pros\Screenshot from Website\`.
